name: buscar_planes
description: Search leisure and culture plans in a Spanish province by date, topic, occasion, keywords, maximum price and distance to some coordinates. Read-only.

arguments.name: provincia
arguments.desc: Province: madrid, barcelona, valencia, sevilla, zaragoza, baleares, castellon, alicante, malaga, asturias, murcia or cadiz

arguments.name: fecha
arguments.desc: Date: hoy, manana, finde, semana or proximasemana

arguments.name: tematica
arguments.desc: Topic, e.g. conciertos, teatro, exposiciones, ninos (see listar_provincias)

arguments.name: ocasion
arguments.desc: Occasion, e.g. pareja, amigos, lluvia, baratos (see listar_provincias)

arguments.name: texto
arguments.desc: Words the plan must contain (title, venue or description)

arguments.name: lat
arguments.desc: Latitude of the reference point for the distance filter

arguments.name: lng
arguments.desc: Longitude of the reference point for the distance filter

arguments.name: radio_km
arguments.desc: Radius in km around lat/lng (default 5, max 100)

arguments.name: limite
arguments.desc: How many plans to return (default 10, max 20)

name: ver_plan
description: Details of one plan: upcoming days, price, venue with address and coordinates, full description and its page on the website. Read-only.

arguments.name: plan
arguments.desc: The plan value returned by buscar_planes, or the URL of its page

arguments.name: provincia
arguments.desc: Province of the plan (not needed if plan is a URL)

name: listar_provincias
description: Provinces with an agenda (and their current plans) and the topic, occasion and date values that buscar_planes accepts. Read-only.
